people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
translations.bsb: Will they not return to the land of Egypt and be ruled by Assyria because they refused to repent?
translations.kjv: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
translations.asv: They shall not return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian shall be their king, because they refused to return to me.
